translations.web: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.
translations.bsb: The light of the eyes cheers the heart, and good news nourishes the bones.
translations.kjv: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat.
translations.asv: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart; And good tidings make the bones fat.
